title: VTN Membership — Repudiate — payload
description: A listed party's repudiation of its listing, or a member's repudiation of its grant. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

repudiation.description: The party's `repudiates/1` statement, issued by the requester about the network, whose `credentialSubject.object.digestMultibase` names the listing or the grant.

Response.title: VTN Membership — Repudiate — response payload
Response.description: The party's entry as it now stands, with its repudiation.
